command_findings.interpretation: Observed concentration is a target-fixation hypothesis, not evidence that those commands were accepted, executed, or tactically wrong.

hypothesis_adjudication.reason: Visual separation and a 162.7-second spread between first local engagements support uneven mutual support; formation geometry remains visual rather than path-simulated.
The second Halberdier unit remained nearly intact until a late 212.1-second first engagement. The stronger supported claim is delayed or uneven reserve commitment, not absence of a reserve.
Local first-engagement times ranged from 49.4 to 212.1 seconds, with major unit losses concentrated among earlier committed elements.
Both artillery units routed early and ranged units retained ammunition while recording low kills; terrain and line-of-fire causality remain visually inferred.
Archaon received 12 of 37 observed targeted command events; selection attribution and tactical correctness remain unverified.
The replay stream ended without BATTLE_COMPLETE, and the final observed state was nonterminal. The original defeat cannot be learned as a replayed terminal outcome.

identity.runtime_battlefield_identity: Battle of Eilhart — Reikland vs Empire Secessionists

next_evidence_gaps: A future live battle result artifact that explicitly records the victorious alliance and grade.
A naturally completed Chaos replay or live observer trace with BATTLE_COMPLETE.
Path, formation, collision, and line-of-fire feasibility.
Independent Chaos battles before calibrating faction-general thresholds.

policy_updates.rule: Never learn outcome, victory grade, defeat irreversibility, or terminal casualty totals from replay-stream exhaustion. Require BATTLE_COMPLETE or a separately bound live result artifact.
Distinguish reserve absent, reserve available, reserve committed late, and reserve unable to support; do not collapse them into one no-reserve diagnosis.
Raise a preservation crisis when elite cavalry incurs extreme losses with negligible observed effect; any proposed disengagement remains subject to legality and feasibility checks.
When one target absorbs a large share of targeted command traffic while multiple threats remain, trigger utility re-evaluation rather than automatically continuing focus.
Use the trace for state recognition, crisis timing, and lower-bound loss diagnosis only; exclude it from terminal-outcome and tactical-superiority training labels.

rejected_promotions: The replay reproduced the original defeat.
The replay-exit zero-loss summary is a valid battle result.
Observed commands were acknowledged or causally executed.
The owner's tactics are optimal-policy labels.
One Chaos replay proves general anti-Chaos tactical superiority.
Lower-bound casualties are exact terminal totals.

unit_findings.note: The elite cavalry lost at least 58 of 60 models while recording one kill; this supports a preservation failure but not a causal explanation.
Tattersouls fell from 160 to one observed model with four kills before the replay stream ended.
Both Helstorm batteries engaged by 49.4 seconds and first routed near 182–185 seconds; one ceased observation at 293.1 seconds.

One Halberdier unit engaged at 140.1 seconds and lost at least 69 models; the other first engaged at 212.1 seconds and lost two, refining the visual 'no reserve' hypothesis into delayed or uneven commitment.
Both local commanders routed at least once and ended the observed stream at low hitpoint fractions.
